theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : Set (Euclid m)) (ρ : Euclid m → ℝ) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid m) (r ε : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ρ → (∀ z, 0 ≤ ρ z) → (∀ z, ε < ‖z‖ → ρ z = 0) → ∫ z, ρ z = 1 → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid m) r → (∀ v, ‖ψ v‖ ≤ 1) → ∃ ψ' : Euclid m → Euclid m, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ' ∧ HasCompactSupport ψ' ∧ tsupport ψ' ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid m) (r + ε) ∧ (∀ v, ‖ψ' v‖ ≤ 1) ∧ ∫ v, (∫ z, ρ z * F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (v - z)) * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid m) (fderiv ℝ ψ v).toLinearMap = ∫ w in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid m) (fderiv ℝ ψ' w).toLinearMap
